parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: Pre-delays audio so the compressor reacts before transients reach the output. Adds equivalent processing latency — comb-filtering occurs if a parallel dry path is in use. Off = zero-latency.

parameters.name: Phase Linear
parameters.description: Adds all-pass compensation so the four bands sum phase-coherently at crossovers. Adds a small fixed group delay (1-3 ms depending on crossover frequencies).

parameters.name: Spectrum View
parameters.description: Show a real-time spectrum analyser below the OUT meter, showing the post-effect output signal. Does not affect audio.
